title: JANUS Cognitive Portfolio Search

JANUS_GATE.role: independent SAT witness and UNSAT Tear verification

positive_claim: A four-candidate typed Observer can soundly solve and compose recognized 2-SAT, Horn, dual-Horn and canonical affine/XOR modules, preserve proof provenance in a deduplicated HRain-style DAG, and recover witnesses through certified definitional unmasking.
obstruction: Generic 3-CNF remains OPEN. Exact search for a useful backdoor/decomposition requires combinatorial subset and assignment exploration. Therefore the fusion improves a polynomial portfolio on a strict structural envelope, but does not supply the missing universal polynomial language/decomposition selector.

surviving_conjecture.name: Representation-Robust Proof-Carrying Selector Conjecture
surviving_conjecture.statement: There exists one deterministic polynomial-time selector which, for every CNF, generates only polynomially many candidate representations/decompositions, chooses tractable proof languages, emits verified SAT witnesses or UNSAT Tears, and preserves polynomial witness recovery.
surviving_conjecture.warning: Constructing this selector is already a polynomial-time SAT algorithm.

hard_boundaries: No unverified language vote is accepted as proof.
No exact extendability query is free.
No recursive four-way expansion is called polynomial without a total-node bound.
No definitional elimination is accepted without a witness-recovery map.
OPEN is a valid result for formulas outside the certified envelope.
